title: KMS rotation replay safelist & evidence-retention orchestrator
creator: Ava Chen
description: Create a safe, auditable orchestration layer that can (1) safelist and gate tenant KMS/HSM key-rotation events, (2) replay rotation events in a sandbox to regenerate verifiable evidence bundles, and (3) enforce configurable evidence retention policies for compliance exports. This ticket covers design, PoC, and integration with existing 'rotation event bus' and the evidence bundler. Goal: enable reproducible evidence for audits and reduce manual forensic work during compliance reviews.
acceptance_criteria: A safelist API that allows PM/security to pre-approve rotation windows per-tenant
A replay harness that can ingest a rotation event stream and reconstruct the key state and wrapped-key artifacts in an isolated environment
Evidence bundle schema versioned and compatible with current auditor toolchain (signed manifest + provenance metadata)
Retention policy enforcement: automatic purging/archival workflows and a retention-exempt audit log
E2E test demonstrating a complete rotation -> replay -> evidence export for a sample tenant (test vectors included)
tasks: Design safelist API and DB model (tenant, rotation-id, window, approver, rationale)
Implement gating middleware for rotation controller to consult safelist
Build replay harness that replays events against a sandbox KMS emulator and emits evidence bundles
Integrate evidence bundler with storage lifecycle (S3 archival + Glacier vault tagging)
Create operator console views for pending rotations and replay jobs
Add metrics and tracing: rotation_requests, safelist_decisions, replay_jobs, evidence_bundle_size
updates: 2026-03-10 - Ava Chen: Created ticket. Initial scope drafted after sync with Security and Compliance. Decision to scope PoC to tenant-scoped rotations only (no multi-region rewrite yet).

2026-03-11 - Diego Ruiz: Reviewed design. Proposing a lightweight safelist table instead of RBAC-heavy approach to speed PoC; will add RBAC later as separate ticket. Noted dependency on rotation event format changes (ENG-607123).

2026-03-11 - Priya Kapoor (Security): Asked for HSM-proof artifacts to include signer certificate chain and HSM firmware index. Marked security_review_required. Added acceptance criterion for signed manifest.

2026-03-12 - Diego Ruiz: PoC plan approved. Spike tasks: (1) KMS emulator container + deterministic key generation, (2) replay harness that accepts JSON event stream and outputs signed bundle. Estimated 5 days for spike. Adding test vectors repository link.
2026-03-12 - Notes: Will use existing evidence-bundler format but add 'replayed_from' metadata. Need a short RFC for the retention policy TTL semantics to avoid accidental data loss during audits.
implementation_notes: Replay harness will run in a customer-isolated sandbox namespace; artifacts generated during replay must be tagged and quarantined. We'll implement a two-phase deletion for retention: soft-delete -> retention-hold -> final purge. Use envelope encryption with tenant KEK for storing evidence bundles. For initial PoC the KEK will be derived from test KMS; production integration requires HSM signing step and attestation chain (follow-up ticket).
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: accidental exposure of key material during replay. Mitigation: sandbox has egress blocked, replay only outputs wrapped/hashed artifacts, never raw private key material. Risk: stale evidence due to retention misconfiguration. Mitigation: retention-exempt audit log and automated retention-testing job scheduled monthly.
qa_plan: Unit tests for safelist CRUD and middleware gate, integration test that runs a full rotation replay against emulator and validates bundle signatures, manual audit-run with Compliance to verify evidence schema. Add chaos test that replays in presence of partial event loss to ensure replay harness detects and fails cleanly.
rollout_plan: 1) Deploy safelist DB + API in staging, gate rotations for a subset of internal tenants. 2) Run 10 replay jobs to validate evidence. 3) Extend to all internal tenants and run compliance audit. 4) Gradual opt-in for customer tenants with explicit consent and communication. 5) Post-mortem and iterate.
next_steps: Start spike for emulator + replay harness (Diego). Draft RFC for retention TTL semantics (Ava). Schedule security review (Priya). Create follow-up ticket for HSM attestation integration after PoC.
